newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai govt cuts 1997 trade deficit projection.
newsitem.headline: Thai govt cuts 1997 trade deficit projection.

text.p: A Thai government panel on Wednesday reduced its 1997 trade deficit forecast to 413 billion baht ($15.88 billion) from 595 billion expected earlier.
The panel said the lower deficit forecast would be three percent lower than the 1996 level.
The government panel, chaired by Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan, also trimmed 1997 projected imports to 1.97 trillion baht from 2.17 trillion seen earlier.
It said the expected lower imports this year would still be seven percent higher than in 1996.
The panel said exports are targeted to grow 10 percent in 1997 to 1.56 trillion baht.
The body also approved medium and long-term measures to boost Thai export competiveness, a panel spokesman said.
